blocks.p: Each chat model wrote its own lessons over its games against GNUbg weak, then took the risk test again. Yes or No is the pre-registered rule's: risks found must rise by more than the model's threshold while right safety drops by no more than the plan allows; an operational threshold, not a statistical test. The other models are still running; their numbers are not results yet.
49 models registered; no accepted result is available yet.

groups.title: Models are too cautious

blocks.p: Most ranked models found a worthwhile risk in a smaller share of the positions where risk paid than the share of positions where safety paid that they played safe. GNUbg weak, a weak setting of the engine, is close to even. Not paired: models met different positions in different leagues.

59 of 60 ranked models · risks found 18.7% ( Mercury Decide ) to 53.3% ( GPT-6 Astra high , late entry) · safe right 16.3% ( GLiClass v4 Edge NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) , late entry) to 97.6% ( Gemini 3.8 Flash high ) · GNUbg weak : 66.6% risks found, 67.6% safe right

groups.title: What thinking adds

blocks.p: The same model at its lowest and its highest reasoning setting, in the same league. Error rate fell for more of them than risk judgement rose. Not paired: each setting played its own games; these are observed differences.

9 models · lower error rate at the highest setting: 9 of 9 · higher risk judgement: 7 of 9 · GPT-6 Astra , low to high (high: late entry): risk judgement 75.8 , 74.7 , 74.4 ; error rate 11.8 , 11.1 , 8.8
